credit.credit-words: Joy in the Service of the Master
WORDS: Daniel S. Warner, 1893. MUSIC: Barney E. Warren, 1893. Public Domain.

Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people. Isa. 52:9 These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full. Jn. 15:11
